fieldNotes.location: 5000A Bohannon Road, Fairburn GA 30213 = Shugart Farms Lake Park Industrial Building A, a Class-A cross-dock DC (~1,037,400 sq ft, built 2016) along I-85 in the Atlanta-South industrial corridor. Roster coords moved 3088m; relocated and confirmed via web (Yellowpages/Waze/TruckMap all place CJ Logistics America at 5000 Bohannon Rd) and satellite.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fencing runs along Bohannon Road frontage (2023 + 2025 Street View). The truck/auto entrance is a divided driveway with separate in/out lanes around a central island; gates set back within the fence line. truckGate=true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the road frontage or just inside the gate in Street View or satellite. The structure earlier suspected at the SW truck court resolved to a water tank / utility, not a booth. Treated as remote check-in.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard booth seen -> remote kiosk / call-box check-in inferred. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: The road entrance is a divided driveway split around a center island with one-way signage -> separate entry and exit lanes.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building with trailers backed in along BOTH long faces (SW face toward I-85 and NE face). For a ~1M sq ft building this implies well over 100 dock doors; estimated ~130. Count is approximate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer storage: ~80-90 trailers visible across the SW and NE truck courts plus a dedicated drop area near the SE end. dropArea 50+, dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on two opposing building faces (SW and NE) function as physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck courts and divided gate apron leave ample paved width to add an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~111 acres from the perimeter box; includes the building, truck courts on both faces, trailer storage, ponds and auto parking.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Fairburn GA along I-85 is part of the dense Atlanta-South metro industrial fabric (multiple million-sqft DCs adjacent) -> Urban.
